verdict.rationale: Factory documents planning before execution: Missions let you define features, milestones and success criteria with Droid before any code is written, and the App shows proposed changes before applying anything. The CLI also lists approvals and tiered autonomy that require manual confirmation. missing for 10: an explicitly documented plan-approval gate (e.g. a spec/plan mode with an approve/reject step), detail on how plans are edited or rejected, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made

citations.quote: Work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written.
Droid analyzes your codebase, proposes changes, and shows what will be modified before applying anything.
interactive terminal UI with project context, approvals, MCP tools, Missions, and headless execution
Droid exec uses tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation.
